text: Application of manure and fertilizer increases the amount of mineral N in soil and leads to higher emission of N$_{2}$O. Most research so far provides emissions for animal manure as such without discriminating between a range of manure qualities that are found in agricultural practice. The results reported here suggest that N$_{2}$O emission may

be quite different depending on manure species and related quality and on manure management and handling. Most of these effects can be attributed to specific manure or fertilizer characteristics.
